shared_elements: frontal standing/enthroned human figure filling the field
elaborate headdress or headgear crowning the head
large circular disc or medallion worn on the chest
symmetrical arrangement of ornaments flanking the torso
banded belt/skirt element across the lower body
vertical, tall panel dominated by a single costumed personage
justification: Both depict a single frontal, elaborately costumed personage occupying the whole tall vertical field, with a broad headdress above, a prominent circular pectoral disc on the chest, symmetrical flanking regalia, and banded belt/skirt elements below — a fairly specific shared scheme of ritual costume display. The biggest differences in content are B's dense low-relief detail, feathered plumes, held objects and a column of framed sign blocks plus a basal cartouche, none of which appear in A, whose figure is rendered in massive, blocky, far more schematic terms without any sign panel.
